summary: This release focuses on faster exports, a redesigned project browser and fixes reported by users.

items.text: Batch export runs in parallel and resumes after a crash.
New --parallel switch for the command-line exporter.
Export presets can be shared between projects.
Filter by tag with #customer style queries.
Fixed a crash when undoing a paste of more than 10 000 objects.
Fixed incorrect kerning for some OpenType fonts.
Fixed zoom level resetting after switching tabs.
